alt: a shelved reading corner with multiple potted plants at varying heights, books, a reading chair, and warm directional light from a side window
text:
a corner knows when it's ready to grow.

four versions of one corner. same shelves, same light, different mood. the third one is where things grow.

#quietrooms #plantblooms #designchoices #cornerlife #shelfscape
note: Filling the frame with many simple props does not create richness. Depth comes from fewer, better elements — material texture, light and composition doing the work.
